Specialty steel and fabricated steel pro.name: Stainless steel and steel pipes
Specialty steel and fabricated steel pro.description: Margins depend on value-added mix and brand, and input steel price swings matter.

Aluminium and copper smelting.name: Aluminium and copper mining and smelting
Aluminium and copper smelting.description: These firms mine or refine bauxite and copper ore into aluminium and copper, earning from metal sold at global-linked prices. Margins track metal prices against power and raw material costs, and captive ore lowers costs.

Stainless steel and steel pipes.name: Steel and alloy pipe and tube makers
Stainless steel and steel pipes.description: These companies buy steel and other metal and turn it into finished pipes and tubes, including black, galvanised, structural, stainless and large diameter pipes. They earn from selling these fabricated products, and what sets this layer apart is that margins depend on value-added product mix and brand rather than on mining or smelting.

Coal, lignite and mineral mining.name: Coal, iron ore and mineral miners
Coal, lignite and mineral mining.description: These companies mine coal, iron ore, bauxite and other minerals, and some also smelt or process them into primary metal. They earn mainly by selling what they extract or make from ore, which sets this layer apart from firms that buy metal and fabricate it.

Zinc, lead and silver mining and smeltin.name: Zinc, lead and silver miners and smelters
Zinc, lead and silver mining and smeltin.description: These companies mine base-metal ores and smelt them into refined zinc, lead, silver and related metals. They earn mainly from selling the ore and primary metal they mine and smelt, with some also selling other mined output. What sets this layer apart is the focus on base-metal ore, by-product silver and smelting tied to global benchmark prices.

Integrated steelmaking.name: Primary steel and stainless producers
Integrated steelmaking.description: These companies make and sell steel and stainless steel from ore and coking coal, and some also mine the raw materials themselves. They earn mainly from selling primary metal, and some also earn from finished products of their own.

It has long-term relationships with top ferrochrome manufacturers and strong supply chain links with iron ore pellet producers.
evidence.NILE: Incorporated in 1984, Nile Ltd is a manufacturer of Pure Lead for battery consumption Business Overview: Company is an ISO 9001:2015 certified secondary manufacturer of Pure Lead and Lead Alloys which are supplied to the manufacturers of Lead Acid batteries, PVC stabilizers and Lead-Oxide. Apart from this, company also deals in Power Generation through windfarms
evidence.NMDC: NMDC is engaged in exploration and production of Iron Ore along with Diamond, production and sale of Sponge Iron and generation and sale of Wind Power.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:119) Business Overview: NMDC is a fully government- owned entity under the Ministry of Steel which specializes in the exploration of minerals including copper, rock phosphate, limestone, magnesite, diamond, and tungsten, and produces a variety of products, including high-grade iron ore with 64% Fe content, diamonds, iron ore pellets, etc.
evidence.ONIXSOLAR: Incorporated in 1980, Onix Solar Energy Ltd is in the business of renewable energy solutions. Business Overview: OSEL was in the business of manufacturing of Gas Products and trading in related products. However, due to its nonperformance in current business line; it has switched its main business from Gas Industry to Solar Energy Industry on May 14th 2024
evidence.ORISSAMINE: Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited was incorporated in 1918. It operates various Iron Ore and Manganese Ore in various districts through leases. HIstory OMDC, incorporated in 1918, was nationalized in 1980, became a Schedule-B PSU in 2010 under Eastern Investment Ltd. (EIL), and later came under Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Ltd. (RINL) after EIL became its subsidiary in 2011.
evidence.POCL: Incorporated in 1995, Pondy Oxides and Chemicals Ltd manufactures Lead Metal and Alloys and other Non-ferrous metals Business Overview: POCL is in the metallic and non-metallic recycling industry as India’s largest secondary Lead manufacturer in Lead Alloys. Its core product, lead and lead alloys, is mainly used in making lead-acid batteries. Company converts scraps of various forms of Lead, Aluminium, and Copper into Lead Metal, Aluminium Metal, Copper, and its Alloys. It carries out smelting of Lead Battery scrap to produce secondary lead metal, which is further transformed into Pure lead and Specific Lead Alloys. Further, company also manufactures Zinc metal and Zinc Oxide
evidence.RATNAMANI: Ratnamani Metals & Tubes Ltd is engaged in the manufacturing of stainless steel pipes and tubes and carbon steel pipes from its manufacturing facilities in India. Business Segments 1) Steel Tubes & Pipes (93%): The company offers nickel alloy/stainless steel seamless tubes & pipes, stainless steel welded tubes & pipes, titanium welded tubes, carbon steel pipes, pipe bends, etc for applications in industries like oil & gas, refineries, thermal power, nuclear power, chemicals, petrochemicals, etc. The segment revenue grew by 53% between FY22 and FY24.
evidence.SAIL: Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) is one of the largest steel-making companies in India and one of the Maharatnas of the countrys Central Public Sector Enterprises. SAIL produces iron and steel at five integrated plants and three special steel plants, located principally in the eastern and central regions of India and situated close to domestic sources of raw materials. SAIL manufactures and sells a broad range of steel products.(Source : Company Web-Site) Business Overview: The company is a state-owned steel producer, with the GOI holding a 65% majority stake as of Mar 2026. It holds Maharatna status and is one of India's largest steel producers.
evidence.SHYAMCENT: Incorporated in 2011, Shyam Century Ferrous Ltd is engaged in manufacturing of Ferro Alloys and generation of Power Business Overview: SCFL is involved in the production of ferro- alloys and generates power to support its manufacturing operations. As a ferro-alloy producer, the company provides raw material for the steel industry.
evidence.SINDHUTRAD: Sindhu Trade Links Ltd is primarily engaged in transportation logistics and support services. The Co. through its subsidiaries is also engaged in diversified businesses like Media, Overseas Coal Mining, BioMass Based Power Generation etc. Business: The Company is engaged in the business of transportation, investment and finance, Petrol Pump Operations, Power Distribution and Engineering Projects and Overseas Mining and Trading of Coal.
evidence.SIZEMASTER: Incorporated in 1999, Sizemasters Technology Ltd manufactures and trades various types of gauges and tools Business Overview: a) SMTL is in the business of manufacturing, sales and distribution of precision gauges, API gauges, thread gauges,special gauges, fixtures, multi gauging, electronic gauging, measuring instruments used in Oil and Gas industry, and tools such as dial gauges and accessories b) It does production of gauges and tools c) It is the 1st Indian Thread Gauge manufacturing company having API Certification ISO 9001 & ISO/IEC 17025:2017 NABL Accreditation.
evidence.SOUTHMG: Incorporated in 1985, Southern Magnesium & Chemicals Ltd is in the business of Magnesium Metal and related goods Business Overview: SMCL is promoted by Dr. N B Prasad and family. It set up a project at Gowripatnam, Andhra Pradesh, to manufacture magnesium metal, in a joint venture with the Andhra Pradesh Industrial Development Corporation. It was the first and only company in India to commercially produce Magnesium Metal
evidence.TATASTEEL: Tata Steel Ltd is Asia's first integrated private steel company setup in 1907. The company has presence across the entire value chain of steel manufacturing from mining and processing iron ore and coal to producing and distributing finished products. The company has a target to increase domestic steelmaking capacity to 30 MnTPA by 2025. Products and Brands: The company manufactures flat products like HR coils, CR coils, galvanised steel, and long products like wire rods, rebars, ferro alloys, tubes, bearings, wires, etc. Its products are sold under 20 brands, including Tata Astrum, Tata Tiscon, Galvano, Tata Steelium, Tata Structura, Tata Agrico, Tata Wiron, Tata Pravish, etc.
evidence.VAML: ⁠Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited was incorporated on 06.10.2023 for the demerger of Vedanta Ltd.’s aluminium undertaking. It is a part of Vedanta group and is the primary aluminium undertaking of the group. About the company: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited was incorporated on 06.10.2023 for the demerger of Vedanta Ltd.’s aluminium undertaking. The demerger became effective on 01.05.2026. VAML allotted ~ 391.04 crore shares of ₹1 each in 1:1 ratio to eligible Vedanta Limited shareholders
evidence.VEDL: Vedanta Ltd is a diversified natural resource group engaged in exploring, extracting and processing minerals and oil & gas. The group engages in the exploration, production and sale of zinc, lead, silver, copper, aluminium, iron ore and oil & gas. It has presence across India, South Africa, Namibia, Ireland, Liberia & UAE. Its other businesses includes commercial power generation, steel manufacturing & port operations in India and manufacturing of glass substrate in South Korea and Taiwan. Presently, India accounts for ~65% of total revenues, followed by Malaysia (9%), China (3%), UAE (1%) and others (22%).
evidence.VISACHROME: Incorporated in 1996, VISA Steel Ltd does manufacturing of High Carbon Ferro Chrome Operational Status: The company has one operating segment - Ferro Alloys . It converts chrome ore and other inputs supplied or financed by a related party into high-carbon ferro chrome. It earns a per-tonne conversion fee plus reimbursement of agreed input and service costs. This keeps the plant operating despite limited working capital and dependence on related-party and creditor support.
